model_annotation: This pie chart displays the distribution of categories within a dataset, as indicated by the paper title. The chart contains six slices representing the categories: chat, math, tooluse, multi turn chat, code, and instruction follow. The slices are colored pink, green, yellow, cyan, blue, and purple respectively. The “chat” category occupies approximately 41.2% of the chart, while “math” represents 21.9%. “Tooluse” accounts for roughly 11.6%, and “multi turn chat” represents 9.3%. The “code” category comprises approximately 9.0% and “instruction follow” makes up 6.9% of the chart. Percentage labels are included within each slice, and a legend is present to identify each category and its corresponding color. The segments appear to be arranged in descending order based on their proportional size.
